notes.title: Version 1.2 Released
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36970697/f35da7732c34d654c90182bafa612f20cfa550e8.png[/img]

Hey everyone,

Version 1.2 is out! I appreciate all of the feedback via reviews and on [url=https://discord.com/invite/kV9kdus]Discord[/url]. In this update I tried to address the 'Keeper' puzzle being too vague as well as various smaller issues.

Version 1.2:
[list]
[*] Added a visual cue to help players call the Keeper within the Apparatus.
[*] Added a twinkling audio cue to help players find the conduits.
[*] Added toggle to disable mouse smoothing.
[*] Fixed various typos in game text.
[*] Fixed various visual hiccups.
[*] Fixed various clipping and collision issues.
[/list]
In a future update I will be addressing some of the performance issues a few of you have reported.

If you haven't already, please consider leaving a review! This helps others discover this strange game about the moon. 

Cheers,
Ben

notes.title: Release Date | New Trailer
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=g3TtwmHoa1A;full][/previewyoutube]

Hi everyone,

I'm so excited to announce that There Was the Moon will be released on July 24, 2020.

This game has been a passion project of mine for the last year or so and I am looking forward to sharing it with you all. If you haven't already, please consider wishlisting so you can be notified when it launches.

Note that preorders are now available on [url=https://benlap.itch.io/there-was-the-moon]Itch[/url]. (Steam key included 💖)

You can follow development on [url=https://discord.gg/kV9kdus]Discord[/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/BenLapid]Twitter[/url].

Thanks,
Ben
